verdict.rationale: The evidence shows NetHunt has distinct contact and company records, from the merge feature, and logs record-level activity such as call summaries, comments, @mentions and attached files. Nothing explicitly documents contacts being linked to companies or a unified activity timeline on each record. missing for 10: documented contact-to-company record linking, an explicit per-record activity timeline aggregating emails, calls and tasks, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, I can manage contacts and companies as linked records with a full activity timeline on each

citations.quote: Get rid of duplicates by merging several contacts, companies, or deals.
Build comprehensive customer profiles with verified contact details.
Keep track of every call with the customer with a summary of a conversation.
Collaborate with collegues by @mentioning them on records or posting comments.
Store and attach files to customer records or deals.
